page_title: BOC 3-3 RBL | Bochum v RB Leipzig 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Here is a change. Dani de Wit is going off and Dieter Hecking gives the last tactical orders to Philipp Hofmann (Bochum).
90+2' We are about to witness a substitution. Lukas Daschner (Bochum) is replacing Myron Boadu.
90+2' It's like he was asking for a caution. Ivan Ordets (Bochum) receives a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Erhan Masovic (Bochum) is coming onto the pitch as Moritz Broschinski cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) meets a perfect cross on the edge of the box and rips a shot that goes well wide of the right post.
82' What a chance that is! Dani de Wit (Bochum) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the right post.
79' Bochum fail to score from a corner as Peter Gulacsi (RB Leipzig) leaps to collect the ball.
78' Bochum take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
76' David Raum (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a pass from Xavi Simons inside the box and quickly shoots, but the effort goes inches over the bar.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ridle Baku departs the field of play to be replaced by Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig).
72' A precise low pass is received by Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
69' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
68' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
68' Here's the change. Arthur Vermeeren (RB Leipzig) leaves the pitch and Amadou Haidara comes on as a substitute.
65' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
64' Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for a foul.
61' 3 - 3 Goal! Myron Boadu (Bochum) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Peter Gulacsi to commit before slotting the penalty into the roof of the net.
61' Myron Boadu (Bochum) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
60' Robert Hartmann blows for a foul after Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a penalty for Bochum!
56' 2 - 3 GOAL! Moritz Broschinski meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Myron Boadu (Bochum) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 2:3.
54' RB Leipzig have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
53' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
48' 1 - 3 Goal! Gerrit Holtmann plays a simple square pass into the feet of Myron Boadu (Bochum) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:3.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.
46' Dieter Hecking has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) comes on the pitch for Felix Passlack.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Robert Hartmann has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Dani de Wit (Bochum) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Felix Passlack (Bochum) serves up a nice cross, but Peter Gulacsi punches the ball away.
37' Bochum can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
37' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well wide of the left post.
33' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bochum will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
33' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the right post.
33' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum.
32' The resulting set piece from Bochum is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
31' Robert Hartmann interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig).
27' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by David Raum (RB Leipzig).
27' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. RB Leipzig will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
22' 0 - 3 Goal! Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from David Raum, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
20' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Felix Passlack (Bochum) was quite harsh and Robert Hartmann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
16' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and RB Leipzig players have a reason to celebrate!
15' Wait! Referee Robert Hartmann has indicated he is going to review the RB Leipzig goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

14' 0 - 2 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Patrick Drewes. 0:2.
10' 0 - 1 Goal! Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
9' Robert Hartmann shows a yellow card to Matus Bero (Bochum) for his blatant foul.
9' The RB Leipzig players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
8' It's a goal! Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) introduces himself with a fine finish.
8' The goal for RB Leipzig is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
3' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
Robert Hartmann will officiate today.
